verses.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·sep̄ ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh ū·šə·māh qə·ṭū·rāh
verses.literal: Now Abraham had taken another wife named Keturah

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־ יָקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־ מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־ יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־ שֽׁוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ lōw ’eṯ- zim·rān wə·’eṯ- yā·qə·šān wə·’eṯ- mə·ḏān wə·’eṯ- miḏ·yān wə·’eṯ- yiš·bāq wə·’eṯ- šū·aḥ
verses.literal: and she bore him Zimran Jokshan Medan Midian Ishbak and Shuah

verses.original: וְיָקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־ דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ים וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·qə·šān yā·laḏ ’eṯ- šə·ḇā wə·’eṯ- də·ḏān ū·ḇə·nê ḏə·ḏān hā·yū ’aš·šū·rim ū·lə·ṭū·šîm ū·lə·’um·mîm
verses.literal: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites the Letushites and the Leummites

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê miḏ·yān ‘ê·p̄āh wā·‘ê·p̄er wa·ḥă·nōḵ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḏā‘ wə·’el·dā·‘āh kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê qə·ṭū·rāh
verses.literal: The sons of Midian were Ephah Epher Hanoch Abida and Eldaah All these were descendants of Keturah

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנוֹ֙ בְּעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liḇ·nê hap·pî·laḡ·šîm ’ă·šer lə·’aḇ·rā·hām nā·ṯan ’aḇ·rā·hām mat·tā·nōṯ way·šal·lə·ḥêm mê·‘al yiṣ·ḥāq bə·nōw bə·‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥay qê·ḏə·māh ’el- ’e·reṣ qe·ḏem
verses.literal: But while he was still alive Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his . . . concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־ חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh yə·mê šə·nê- ḥay·yê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer- ḥāy mə·’aṯ šā·nāh wə·šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nîm
verses.literal: Abraham - lived a total of . . . . . . 175 . . . . . . . . . . . . years

verses.original: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מָת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yā·māṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām bə·śê·ḇāh ṭō·w·ḇāh zā·qên wə·śā·ḇê·a‘ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died . . . old and contented and was gathered to his people

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל־ שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־ צֹ֙חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiš·mā·‘êl bā·nāw ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ham·maḵ·pê·lāh ’el- śə·ḏêh ‘ep̄·rōn ben- ṣō·ḥar ha·ḥit·tî ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê mam·rê
verses.literal: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near . . . Mamre in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵי־ חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְשָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer- qā·nāh ’aḇ·rā·hām mê·’êṯ bə·nê- ḥêṯ šām·māh qub·bar ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·śā·rāh ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: This was the field that Abraham . . . had bought from the Hittites . . . Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם־ בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê mō·wṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām way·ḇā·reḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq bə·nōw way·yê·šeḇ yiṣ·ḥāq ‘im- bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î
verses.literal: After Abraham’s death God blessed his son Isaac who lived near Beer-lahai-roi

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·lə·ḏōṯ yiš·mā·‘êl ben- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh hā·ḡār ham·miṣ·rîṯ šip̄·ḥaṯ śā·rāh lə·’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael whom Hagar the Egyptian Sarah’s maidservant bore to Abraham

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֑ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiš·mā·‘êl biš·mō·ṯām lə·ṯō·wl·ḏō·ṯām bə·ḵōr yiš·mā·‘êl nə·ḇā·yōṯ wə·qê·ḏār wə·’aḏ·bə·’êl ū·miḇ·śām
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael then Kedar Adbeel Mibsam

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·mā‘ wə·ḏū·māh ū·maś·śā
verses.literal: Mishma Dumah Massa

verses.original: חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḏaḏ wə·ṯê·mā yə·ṭūr nā·p̄îš wā·qê·ḏə·māh
verses.literal: Hadad Tema Jetur Naphish and Kedemah

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: êl·leh hêm bə·nê yiš·mā·‘êl wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·ṯām bə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem ū·ḇə·ṭî·rō·ṯām šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār nə·śî·’im lə·’um·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: These were the sons of Ishmael and these were their names by their villages and encampments twelve . . . princes of their tribes

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מָת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·nê ḥay·yê yiš·mā·‘êl mə·’aṯ šā·nāh ū·šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm way·yiḡ·wa‘ way·yā·māṯ way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: Ishmael lived a total of . . . 137 . . . . . . . . . . . . years Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־ שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י כָל־ אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kə·nū mê·ḥă·wî·lāh ‘aḏ- šūr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·ra·yim bō·’ă·ḵāh ’aš·šū·rāh ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl ’e·ḥāw nā·p̄āl
verses.literal: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ yiṣ·ḥāq ben- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’aḇ·rā·hām hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac Abraham became the father of Isaac

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־ רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî yiṣ·ḥāq ben- ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bə·qaḥ·tōw ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl hā·’ă·ram·mî mip·pad·dan ’ă·rām ’ă·ḥō·wṯ lā·ḇān hā·’ă·ram·mî lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: and Isaac was forty years old . . . when he married Rebekah the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean

verses.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽיהוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye‘·tar yiṣ·ḥāq Yah·weh lə·nō·ḵaḥ ’iš·tōw kî ‘ă·qā·rāh hî way·yê·‘ā·ṯer lōw Yah·weh wat·ta·har riḇ·qāh ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife because she was barren And the LORD heard his prayer and his wife Rebekah conceived

verses.original: וַיִּתְרֹֽצֲצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·rō·ṣă·ṣū hab·bā·nîm bə·qir·bāh wat·tō·mer ’im- kên lām·māh zeh ’ā·nō·ḵî wat·tê·leḵ liḏ·rōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the children inside her struggled with each other and she said . . . . . . Why is this happening to me So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י גֹיִים בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh lāh šə·nê ḡō·yīm bə·ḇiṭ·nêḵ ū·šə·nê lə·’um·mîm mim·mê·‘a·yiḵ yip·pā·rê·ḏū ū·lə·’ōm mil·’ōm ye·’ĕ·māṣ wə·raḇ ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ ṣā·‘îr
verses.literal: and He declared to her Two nations are in your womb and two peoples from within you will be separated one people will be stronger than the other and the older will serve the younger

verses.original: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lə·’ū yā·me·hā lā·le·ḏeṯ wə·hin·nêh ṯō·w·mim bə·ḇiṭ·nāh
verses.literal: When her time came to give birth there were indeed twins in her womb

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hā·ri·šō·wn ’aḏ·mō·w·nî kul·lōw kə·’ad·de·reṯ śê·‘ār way·yiq·rə·’ū šə·mōw ‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: The first one came out red . . . covered with hair like a fur coat so they named him . . . Esau

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָד֤וֹ אֹחֶ֙זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yā·ṣā ’ā·ḥîw wə·yā·ḏōw ’ō·ḥe·zeṯ ba·‘ă·qêḇ ‘ê·śāw way·yiq·rā šə·mōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiṣ·ḥāq ben- šiš·šîm šā·nāh bə·le·ḏeṯ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: After this his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel so he was named . . . Jacob And Isaac was sixty years old . . . when the twins were born

verses.original: וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·də·lū han·nə·‘ā·rîm way·hî ‘ê·śāw ’îš yō·ḏê·a‘ ṣa·yiḏ ’îš śā·ḏeh wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’îš tām yō·šêḇ ’ō·hā·lîm
verses.literal: When the boys grew up Esau became a skillful hunter a man of the field while Jacob . . . was a quiet man who stayed at home

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־ עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־ צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- ‘ê·śāw kî- ṣa·yiḏ bə·p̄îw wə·riḇ·qāh ’ō·he·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game he loved Esau but Rebekah loved Jacob

verses.original: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·zeḏ ya·‘ă·qōḇ nā·zîḏ way·yā·ḇō ‘ê·śāw min- haś·śā·ḏeh wə·hū ‘ā·yêp̄
verses.literal: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew Esau came in from the field and was famished

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־ הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־ כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־ שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ hal·‘î·ṭê·nî nā min- hā·’ā·ḏōm hā·’ā·ḏōm haz·zeh kî ‘ā·yêp̄ ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘al- kên qā·rā- šə·mōw ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: He said to Jacob Let me eat . . . some of that red stew for I am famished That is why . . . he was also called . . . Edom

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ בְּכֹֽרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ miḵ·rāh ḵay·yō·wm ’eṯ- bə·ḵō·rā·ṯə·ḵā lî
verses.literal: First sell me your birthright Jacob replied

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־ זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ê·śāw hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ lā·mūṯ wə·lām·māh- zeh lî bə·ḵō·rāh
verses.literal: Look said Esau I am about to die . . . so what good . . . is a birthright to me

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־ בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ hiš·šā·ḇə·‘āh lî kay·yō·wm way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lōw way·yim·kōr ’eṯ- bə·ḵō·rā·ṯōw lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Swear to me first Jacob said So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קָם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־ הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ nā·ṯan lə·‘ê·śāw le·ḥem ū·nə·zîḏ ‘ă·ḏā·šîm way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yā·qām way·yê·laḵ way·yi·ḇez ‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- hab·bə·ḵō·rāh
verses.literal: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau who ate and drank and then got up and went away Thus Esau despised his birthright
